entries.title: Hermes Agent v0.23.3
entries.note: Hermes Agent v0.23.3 Release Date: November 19, 2026 Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~370 PRs merged since v0.23.2 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0. About this release Measured at commit caafe5389ae , the window since v0.23.2 contains 1,657 non-merge commits across 3,948 changed files (+222,379 / −96,154), 370 merged PRs and 60 closed issues . Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: one prompt-cache lifecycle controller (warming through long tool runs, compaction of idle chats before the 1h cache expires, Nous Portal on the full 1h lifecycle, prompt_caching.cache_ttl defaulting to auto ), compaction that archives the tool results it drops, the proactive tool-result prune on by default, a one-question first-run CLI setup with the free tier
